authorization: User explicitly requested merge to main and production deployment.
release_blockers: Exact evaluated prompt/runtime hashes and eight reviewed v2 development answers
Scoped clean backend/frontend/infrastructure tests and builds
Production target identity verification before writes
Additive migrations preserve scientific records and existing chat pointers
Only reviewed v2 prompt publishes, with original evaluations retained privately and hashes verified after retrieval
CDK diff contains no experiment-instance, AMI, unrelated-stack or database data changes
deployment_order: Commit and merge backend source and pin its committed revision
Archive original model outputs/protocols and publish exact evaluated v2 prompt
Merge infrastructure and deploy only JumpServeBenchmarkStack and JumpServeAgentStack
Merge frontend and release Amplify main
Verify deployed source hashes, public capabilities/navigation, desktop/mobile themes, privacy denials and sign-in return paths
ci_scope: Manual scoped release follows declared blockers. Merge commits use [skip ci] to avoid unrelated benchmark AMI rebuilding and all-stack deployments; no protected required status checks are bypassed. Source commits and precise merge/deployment receipts are retained.
conditional_checks: Legitimate Google-authenticated owner planning/fresh review request; no session will be fabricated
Deployed cross-owner write denial requires two legitimate sessions
Independent human/domain review and held-out ideas
scientific_scope: No new research hypothesis is tested. Planning recommendations are model outputs; domain jobs remain manual. Development regressions are not independent scientific validation.

resources.evaluation_basis: Reuse exact eight passed actual v2 answers only if prompt/runtime hashes match
resources.billing: Retain available AWS/Storage/Amplify usage. Missing measured or estimated charges stay null.

rollback: Retain migrations, datasets and publication history. Restore prior Lambda code or disable the idea prompt/UI through a recorded authorized release; never drop scientific data.
